original_query: Which achieved better performance in the year Nestlé acquired Prometheus, Organic Growth or Real Internal Growth?

summaries.found_via_query: What were the performance metrics of Organic Growth and Real Internal Growth at the time of Nestlé's acquisition of Prometheus?
summaries.summary: This slide from Nestlé's 2011 Full Year Results Roadshow (February 21st, 2012) displays 10 years of organic growth and EBIT margin improvement, with bar charts showing annual performance from 2001 to 2011. The 10-year annual averages are 6.4% for Organic Growth and 3.6% for Real Internal Growth. A line graph shows EBIT margin trends, ending at 15.0% in 2011. The data is noted as corresponding to published figures, not restated for accounting changes.
key_facts: 10-year annual average Organic Growth: 6.4%
10-year annual average Real Internal Growth: 3.6%
EBIT margin trend line ends at 15.0% in 2011
Data corresponds to published figures, not restated for accounting changes
